answer: Each agent posts a small time-locked deposit, refunded only after completing an honest epoch of verified work. Reputation accrues to this bonded stake, so a sybil attacker must lock fresh capital in every fake identity and keep each alive through every epoch pulse before payout. Misbehavior or dormancy forfeits the stake. Sustaining thousands of fakes through each dawn cycle becomes capital-intensive with negative expected return, while honest agents pay only temporary illiquidity on their growing ridge of stake, returned after honest epochs.
